name: Vectoree
description: Model gateway with $5 welcome credit after CLI login; 36+ models on one key.
overview: Vectoree is a gateway over 36+ models including a vectoree/auto router, reachable at vectoree.ai/api/v1 in the OpenAI shape. New organisations receive a $5 welcome credit once the CLI is linked to a project, with no card required for that credit; after it is spent, calls draw from a prepaid wallet and an empty wallet stops the gateway. Auth, database and storage come bundled with the same account.
free_access: OpenAI-compatible gateway with a vectoree/auto router
36+ models on one key including DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and Qwen
Hard stop when the wallet is empty — no automatic overage
notes: The credit is one-time and the pricing page does not quote a token amount; treat it as roughly $5 of list-price usage. Verifying the credit requires the CLI login flow.
